summary: Volusia County tower near Lake Ashby, shown on a 1966 USGS map and registered in 2016; its entry notes footer repairs in the mid-2010s. Build date and height not found.

facts.status_note: Last documented as standing in its 2016 register entry, which mentions footer repairs; no later condition report was found.
facts.agency: Florida Department of Agriculture & Consumer Services

access.note: The register entry does not describe public access or climbing rules for the tower.

events.note: Listed as a significant local landmark on a 1966 USGS survey, published 1968 and based on 1957 photogrammetry
Registered July 24, 2016 as US 1070, FL 17; nominated by Robert Spear

evidence.supports: Tower sits in central Volusia County near Lake Ashby
evidence.quote: Lake Ashby dominates this central Volusia County landscape

evidence.supports: Ashby Lookout Tower listed as a significant local landmark on the map
evidence.quote: Significant local landmarks include the Ashby Lookout Tower

evidence.supports: Repairs to footers in the mid-2010s
evidence.quote: This tower received extensive repairs to its footers in the mid-2010s.

evidence.supports: Administered by Florida Department of Agriculture & Consumer Services
evidence.quote: Florida Department of Agriculture & Consumer Services

sources.title: 1966 Map of Lake Ashby, Alamana, FL (USGS topo, published 1968)

notes_for_editor: No build date, design, height, or staffing found in the two sources read. The NHLR 'Elevation' of 27 ft (8 m) is ground elevation, so the brief's elevation_m 8.2 is not a tower height. The map's 1957 photogrammetry suggests the tower stood by then, but that is an inference, not a stated date. The Eastern Lookouts Ashby page has only a name and county, so it was not cited. Page reads: 6.
